purpose: Teach: アドベンチャー/ヒルトン/ハーレム/エイリアン/ゴルファー/トークショー/東映/バイエルン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアドベンチャー映画に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he's going to take you to an adventure movie.
lines.style: Warm, approving tone. Soft, conversational delivery. A slight upward lift on 'adventure' — genuine delight in the plan. Relaxed pace, the voice of a mother sharing good news naturally.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとヒルトンホテルに泊まったよ
lines.en: Mom, I stayed at the Hilton with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick onset on the first word. Bouncy rhythm, can't quite contain the energy. Genuine pride — he's reporting something important he did. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハーレム漫画は子供は読まないって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad mentioned that harem manga isn't something kids read.
lines.style: Gentle but clear boundary-setting. Calm, steady tone — not scolding, just informing. A light firmness underneath, the kind that doesn't need to raise volume. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエイリアンのアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched an Alien anime with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, unfiltered reporting. Quick pace, overlapping energy. Pride in what he experienced — he's sharing, not boasting. A little breathlessness from the excitement of the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴルファーになるための練習を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad showed you how he practices to be a golfer.
lines.style: Warm reflection. Softer pace than her first line. A slight smile in the voice — remembering the scene. Tender acknowledgment of the effort Dad put in. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとトークショーの収録見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Dad filming a talk show!
lines.style: Rapid-fire report, pure unguarded enthusiasm. Short, staccato phrases. The voice of a child who can't wait to tell the whole story. Genuine awe at what he witnessed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが東映の映画祭に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's taking you to the Toei film festival.
lines.style: Quiet pleasure. Slower, more measured than the eager lines. Appreciative tone — recognizing something special being offered. Slight trailing inflection, like she's savoring the news as she shares it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがバイエルンの試合中継を観てらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was watching the Bayern match!
lines.style: Compressed excitement with a finishing warmth. Quick delivery but settling slightly at the end. The satisfied tone of someone reporting a completed, wonderful moment. Small tail-off.
